title: Myth: Shangri-La

tiers.everyday: Shangri-La is a made-up valley in the Himalayas from James Hilton's 1933 novel Lost Horizon. It is fiction, not a lost city.
tiers.student: A library catalog record of Lost horizon (New York: William Morrow & Co., 1933) by James Hilton (1900-1954, per the Library of Congress) summarises the novel as set in Shangri-La, a Himalayan place where time has almost stopped. The story's source is the novel; a real Shangri-La at a known place is not proven.

claims.text: Shangri-La comes from James Hilton's novel Lost Horizon (1933)
Shangri-La is a real place at a known location
claims.note: No cited source places it; we draw no pin.
